Chapter 6872: Primordial Eight Variations

Chapter 6872: Primordial Eight Variations

Big-foot Immortal’s expression soured since the remark touched a sore spot.

He was an immortal since the start of Golden Mortal World. After all of this time, he was still a grand immortal, not even a golden immortal.

Although this was an unreachable realm for nearly all cultivators, Bear Immortal spoke as if he were a clown.

“A little immortal such as yourself dares to speak so haughtily?” He retorted.

“We’re in the same realm, so you’re a little immortal as well. You have fallen into the darkness so your cultivation will never improve.” Bear responded.

This was indeed the truth. Big-foot knew it was over for any improvement after falling.

“Demon bear, prepare for death!” He shouted and channeled his power.

Gigantic metal plates attached to his feet, wrapping them up entirely like armor.

“Mortal Mecha-boots.” Six-foot Monarch murmured, having heard of this artifact before. This used to be their heirloom.

Golden Lamp became engulfed by darkness. Cracks appeared everywhere even before the foot fully descended.

Bear Immortal’s primordial waves immediately retaliated.

“Bam!” Unfortunately, it couldn’t move the stomp this time. The armored boots blazed brightly, repelling the primordial waves.

“Bring it!” Bear leaped away from his mountain and swung a saber using his mouth. The light from the slash had a celestial affinity capable of igniting worlds.

It pushed back the repelled waves on top of stopping the metal boot.

“Primordial Eight Variations!” He left Golden Lamp and spun in the air, slashing repeatedly with lightning speed.

Despite using his mouth instead of his hand, his style was impeccable and unleashed all available affinities. The targeted area was sliced into still images.

Although the inhabitants couldn’t see the mysteries, they still felt everything stop.

Finally, all eight variations became one ultimate slash. It cut through the armor and made him stagger in pain. The slash continued through the foot and nearly severed him.

Of course, an immortal couldn’t be killed so easily. It required someone far stronger to do so.

“Just a little immortal.” Bear didn’t forget to pour salt on the wound.

“Ooo!” A summon horn sounded and interrupted their battle.

“Buzz.” A golden bull made from stars came out of a spatial hole, initiating a merciless thrust against Bear.

The horn continued and another giant appeared from the spatial hole. His crescent blade felt like a galaxy and released stars to surround Bear Immortal. The stars then exploded with devastating impact.

Next came a metallic fortress that seemed to be alive. It immediately fired a blinding beam.

“Primordial Eight Variations.” Bear performed the same technique, hoping to freeze all affinities.

However, Eight-foot saw an opening and teleported behind him. His speed was boosted by the blazing armor.

“Eternal Foot Dao!” He shouted and stomped again, piercing through space and time for a direct hit on the bear’s back.
